scientific_hypothesis: Because the coefficient field contains only the first three transverse harmonics, the boundary-response kernel is locally structured in input/output frequency. A learner that shares one scalar kernel across both mode indices should infer unseen drive directions progressively from partial orthogonal coverage.
rival: The coupled response remains direction-specific at the required accuracy; spectral locality either cannot represent the exact operator or does not turn partial target fields into held-out directional accuracy.

instrument.role: Measurement of the spectral-locality hypothesis, not a proposed final architecture.
instrument.contract: Exact linearity in the eight boundary coefficients. One scalar coordinate network is evaluated for every propagation location, retained output mode, and input mode.
features: sine and cosine propagation features at 1, 2, 4, and 8 cycles
instrument.network: Three hidden SiLU layers of width 128 and one scalar output.

protocol.target_design: The nested orthogonal design frozen in nonseparable_target_saturation_orthogonal_amendment_2026-07-29.json.
protocol.evaluation: Exact expected relative root-mean-square error on held-out boundary drives, computed from the learned response matrix.

registered_gates.capacity: Capacity-control geometric-mean error at most 0.5%, with every seed at most 0.75%.
registered_gates.target_threshold: Eight-field geometric-mean target-only error at most 1.5%.
registered_gates.one_field_not_saturated: One-field geometric-mean target-only error at least 2.5%.
registered_gates.material_improvement: Four-field error at most 80% and eight-field error at most 50% of one-field error.
registered_gates.monotonicity: Geometric-mean target-only error strictly decreases at every budget.

decision_rule: All gates must pass before source transfer is measured. Capacity failure refutes this spectral-local representation at the declared size and schedule. Saturation failure refutes its use as the transfer instrument even if capacity passes.
scope: A pass would validate one exploratory instrument on one nonseparable elliptic family, not establish architecture robustness.
A failure does not refute all cross-frequency priors; it refutes this explicit local-coordinate hypothesis at the declared resolution.
No source-trained result is run or inspected during this gate.
